evidence_observed: All six exist and pass python -m py_compile. Conformance passes on the full default surface. The gate test itself was amended on 2026-09-25: it previously passed if a script existed OR if a DEV-TODO marker was still in the recipe, so it could be satisfied by doing nothing.
handoff_condition: Every one of the six step scripts exists and compiles.
residual_risk: Existence and compilation, not correctness. The scripts are exercised by the sample corpus, but no independent test suite covers them and none runs in CI.
scope: This decision covers the sample run over the frozen fixture corpus only.
voids_if: Any edit to the recipe or its six step scripts, any change to the fixture corpus, or a switch out of sample mode voids this decision.
